basic_info.description: 1 years worth of HOA paid for. Welcome to Residence #1200, a stunning condominium offering nearly 1,000SF of refined luxury in the historic Hills Plaza. With south-facing water views & elegant upgrades throughout, this residence embodies sophisticated city living. Step into the remodeled kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances & ample space to cook. The living & dining area boasts custom built-ins and breathtaking water views from every angle, creating the perfect ambiance for relaxation or entertaining guests. The expansive bedroom offers enough space for a home office & includes a large walk-in closet. The luxurious bathroom features a dual vanity & travertine stone flooring. A washer, dryer & wine-fridge complete this home. Additionally there is deeded parking & separate storage. Located at the intersection of the Bay's natural beauty & the energy of San Francisco's tech hub, Hills Plaza offers unparalleled convenience & amenities. Home to Google, Mozilla Firefox, & the Wharton School, this prestigious address includes a 24-hour concierge & a landscaped rooftop terrace spanning ~7,000 square feet with unmatched water & bridge views. Conveniently located steps away from The Embarcadero, Ferry Building, Woodlands Grocery Store, Sales Force Park, restaurants, cafes & more.
